blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — SaaS & Platform Companies
blocks.note: The flow is linear on purpose: every hop owns its latency budget and failure policy, and a regression in one stage is a cohort, never an estate-wide surprise.

blocks.x: The architecture for SaaS & Platform Companies is deliberately auditable: every stage exposes its inputs, its owner and its failure policy, and the decision path shares a timeline with the audit path. Nothing important happens off the record.
